acceptance: 4/4 holdouts, 7/7 native HTTP anchors, all 106 existing workspace tests retained, workspace build and production audit pass. No source/API/schema/persistence changes outside client transport. Full Rust/CI safeguards remain separate merge requirements.
retry_semantics: Preserve existing total-attempt semantics: max(1,retries); retry HTTP 429, HTTP >=500 and deadline aborts, with 1000ms exponential backoff; do not introduce replay of other network failures.
scope: Per-attempt deadline covers connection, headers and response body; timer cleanup on every exit before retry backoff. No new persistence, no external service calls in evaluation, no deployment. Neutral Flywheel cost input is not a measured cost.
